terms.title: Alantech - Scope of Supply (Water Treatment)
terms.terms:
Included are, in addition to the scope of supply mentioned in our quotation:

  • Maximum possible pre-assembly of the plant in our works
  • General assembly plan, flow sheet
  • Operating instructions and maintenance instructions, 2 printed copies
  • Suppliers operating instructions, maintenance instructions and spare part lists
  • Spare part lists, 2 printed copies.
  • Painting material for external painting of tanks resp. patching-up
  • Supervision of unloading, transportation and placing of the equipment,

If the installation is made by Alantech, not included are all items unless stated in our above offer, particularly:

  • Freight and insurance, customs clearing and duties
  • Work of unloading on site, transport within the site and placing
  • Civil works, masonry, foundations, flooring, works
  • All feed/discharge piping, drains, lighting systems
  • Cranes, forklifts, scaffolds for erection
  • Cables and electrical installation to be executed by a licensed local company.
  • Compressed control air supply
  • Installation tools and welding equipment incl. welding gases
  • Steam- or hot water supply pipes and insulation
  • Local work- and operating permissions
  • Special certifications, inspections/tests, equipment passports required in buyer´s country
  • Passivation of pipelines, the required chemicals and their disposal
  • Costs of water, power and chemicals for testing and plant start-up
  • Any taxes or duties payable in customers country, especially on the costs of installation, start-up, training and other local works carried out by Alantech.

We draw your attention to the fact that treatment plants are consuming own water (partially treated water), for example for:

  • Filter-backwash incl. filtrate to drain
  • Regeneration
  • Sterilization and cooling down
  • Cleaning
  • Reject water of membrane filtration plants
  • Measuring water

During the backwash, cleaning, sterilization etc. of plant units, the related treatment capacity is not available, unless we are expressively offering stand by-units or double alternating plants.

terms.title: Alantech - Commercial Conditions (Water Treatment)
terms.terms:
Time of ex works delivery

Approx. [[24]] weeks after acceptance of the P&ID, layout by customer and after receipt of down payment. A later change of the plant execution by the customer may result in a prolongation of the time of delivery and to additional charges.

Price basis is the {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(offer_date) }}

The validity of the offer is [[3]] months, subject stainless steel material prices being unchanged. In case of substantial changes, we reserve the right to adjust the prices for stainless steel items accordingly.

Terms of delivery

Ex-works Cochin, India, according to Inco-terms 2010. Costs of freight, packing, installation and commissioning are stated separately. Costs for taking back and disposal of packing material are not included in the price.

Plant execution

Alantech components/plants are offered according to our latest state of design and technology. We reserve to make minor changes in design upon execution of the order. Major changes will be agreed upon.

Terms of payment

[[50]]% Advance along with order.

[[45]]% before shipment, After FAT.

[[5]]% - after successful commissioning

All payment are to be effected net without deduction.

The payments are to be made by Bank Transfer.

Guarantees

We warrant that the workmanship, equipment and materials are of full merchantable quality. Alantech provide [[12]] months warranty for the equipments for workmanship and design. All wear and tear parts as well as all consumables are excluded from our guarantee.

settings.intro_text:
We thank you for the interest you have shown for our product. We take pleasure in quoting for the same.

Below you will find offer for automated water treatment plant for the [[canal water and municipal water]] with [[pre filters, Clarifier, UF, RO, RO, EDI and NRMB]].

Capacity of the water treatment plant is [[160,000]] Ltr / hour of RO permeate ([[1,824,000]] Ltr per day total), with [[93.0]]% overall recovery rate.
settings.water_analysis_intro:
The following raw water analysis will be the basis for the plant design. In addition to these parameters thresholds for the offered treatment plant design are given below. Any parameters not mentioned are expected to be in compliance with client’s specifications for treated water, the WHO guidelines for drinking water or local standards for drinking water, whichever is more strict. Any parameters that exceed below mentioned thresholds must be noted to Alantech since it may effect the offered plant design.

Any damage to Alantech plant or non-compliant treated water quality resulting from a deviating raw water quality is excluded from warranty.
settings.water_analysis_remarks:
• Please study the raw water analysis stated above very carefully, as it is the basis for the plant design. Kindly inform us, if you do not agree with this analysis, especially if you experienced larger fluctuations of the stated data in the past.
  • The analysis only shows the situation at the time the samples have been taken. Therefore please provide as many "historical" water data as available, at least of the past year. Otherwise we will consider the stated analysis as typical for your raw water quality.
  • Substances which are not stated in the analysis are deemed not to be detected/able or to be within the permissible limits upon treatment by the offered water treatment technology.

sub_assemblies.description:
Alantech equipment specified in our quotation, incl. internal plant piping. We are presupposing a continuous, undisturbed installation with start-up/commissioning directly after installation.

All local preparations by customer such as paved access roads to the installation place, civil works, masonry, foundations, sewage system, tiling, piping to and off the plant, raw water and power supply etc. are to be ready before installation. For the storage of all plant components and materials the customer shall provide a lockable or guarded, dry, sun-protected and frost-free room adjacent to the place of installation. If plant components and materials must be stored distant from the place of installation, the transport within the site shall be provided by the customer at any time needed during installation.

Prior to departure of our Engineer the customer shall confirm by a Alantech checklist full readiness of the site. Trips made in vain/waiting times due to missing customer's preparation will be charged. Unless installation tools and ancillaries are included in our scope of supply, waiting times caused by unavailability of installation tools/welding gas will be charged.

The customer shall provide free of charge

  • food and lodging for Alantech personnel
  • local transportation of the Alantech personnel
  • local personnel/helpers, i.e. 2 - 3 helpers
  • crane, heavy lifting equipment and personnel for bringing the plant equipment to the installation place
  • electric power for installation, water, steam, compressed air, CO2 (if needed) and chemicals for start-up
  • drainage/disposal of startup water, chemicals etc.
  • installation tools incl. stainless steel welding equipment and welding gases (Argon B 50 UN 1006 compressed 4.6) or equivalent.

Please note that upon installation/startup considerable water quantities are needed for example for plant cleaning, backwash of freshly filled filters etc. Example: For 1st backwash of a filter of 3,2 m diameter abt. 1000 m³ are required.

One week prior to startup and during startup/commissioning the customer shall make permanently available at least one operator, electrician and maintenance engineer to work and to be trained under the guidance of our startup engineer. If this personal will not be provided, we are entitled to send additional startup personal on customer's account and to charge an extended stay for training of customer's personal after startup.

Apart from "training on the job" 1-2 days are provided for the training of the customer's personal.
